I'm James Cook, a controls engineer. My PhD applied deep and reinforcement
learning to engine modelling and optimization, and I've spent most of my career
on UAV flight controls and drone programs.

I learn best from pictures and real examples, and most material on machine
learning offers one or the other, rarely both. This site is my attempt to fix
that: every lesson starts from a real problem, every idea gets a picture, and the
hardest ideas, like how tensors move through a transformer, get a picture you can
step through.

Everything here is open source. If something is wrong or unclear, open an issue
on [GitHub](https://github.com/jamesc91/jimcyclopedia).
